keyframes.prompt: Vertical 2:3 photorealistic photo of a ripe soybean field in the countryside of northern Vietnam, at golden hour. Close-up of several soybean plants with many fuzzy golden-brown ripe soybean pods in the center of the frame, a few pods split open showing pale yellow beans. Blurred background: soybean field, green bamboo and a distant old tiled roof. Warm sunlight from the left. Shallow depth of field. No people. Keep the pods inside the middle 70 percent of the width. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. The soybeans have been harvested. Show a top-down view of a large round dented aluminum basin filled with clear water, with many plump pale yellow soybeans soaking at the bottom, sitting in the center of a rustic dark wooden table. A few dry soybean pods lie on the table at the top edge. Same warm golden light from the left. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the same basin, the same top-down camera, the same table and the same light. The soybeans and clear water are gone: the basin is now filled with smooth creamy white soy milk. At the top edge of the frame, the lower part of a traditional grey stone hand mill is visible, with a thin stream of white soy milk flowing from it into the basin. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the same top-down camera, the same wooden table and the same warm light. The camera has moved a little to the right: the basin is now only partly visible at the left edge. In the center is a large pot of hot soy milk where soft white tofu curds have formed, floating in pale yellow whey, a little steam rising, a ladle resting on the rim. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the same top-down camera, the same wooden table and the same warm light. The camera has moved a little to the right: the pot is now only partly visible at the left edge. In the center is a square wooden tofu mold lined with white cheesecloth, filled with one firm smooth pressed block of white tofu, the cloth folded open, a little water on the wood. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the same top-down camera, the same wooden table and the same warm light. The mold and cloth are gone: the same white tofu block now lies on a wooden cutting board in the center, cut into neat small square pieces, a kitchen knife next to it. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the same top-down camera, the same wooden table and the same warm light. The camera has moved a little to the right: the cutting board is now only partly visible at the left edge. In the center is a black frying pan with hot bubbling oil, full of puffed golden crispy fried tofu squares. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the same top-down camera, the same wooden table and the same warm light. The camera has moved a little to the right: the frying pan is now only partly visible at the left edge. In the center is a wooden cutting board with neatly arranged thin slices of boiled pork leg with skin, white fat and pink meat, glistening, a little steam. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the same top-down camera, the same wooden table and the same warm light. The camera has moved a little to the right: the pork board is now only partly visible at the left edge. In the center is a small white bowl of thick purple fermented shrimp paste (mam tom), with a squeezed lime half and a small spoon of white sugar on top, a pair of wooden chopsticks next to the bowl. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the same bowl, the same top-down camera, the same table and the same light. The lime and sugar are gone: the shrimp paste is now whipped into a light purple foamy froth with many small bubbles on top, a few slices of red chili floating on it, the chopsticks resting across the bowl. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the same top-down camera, the same wooden table and the same warm light. The camera has moved a little to the right: the shrimp paste bowl is now only partly visible at the left edge. In the center is a round flat woven bamboo tray lined with a green banana leaf, with pressed rice vermicelli cakes (bun la) cut into squares, golden fried tofu squares, sliced boiled pork leg and a few pieces of green rice cha com, neatly arranged. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the same bamboo tray and the same food, the same wooden table and the same warm light. The camera is a little higher and wider. Fresh Vietnamese herbs (perilla, kinh gioi), sliced cucumber and lime wedges have been added to the tray, and the small bowl of frothy purple shrimp paste with red chili sits next to the tray, with a pair of wooden chopsticks. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Same tray of bun dau mam tom, same table, same warm light, but now a close-up seen from a low 45-degree side angle. In the center, a pair of wooden chopsticks holds one golden crispy fried tofu square dipped into the small bowl of light purple frothy shrimp paste, a little froth clinging to the tofu. The tray and herbs are softly blurred behind. Keep the chopsticks and tofu inside the middle 70 percent of the width. No text, no watermark.
